title: Panel references a concept that isn't declared
body: A panel's data source points at a concept that the model doesn't declare (the diagnostic says "entity"). Either the name is misspelled, or the concept was never added. Fix: add the missing concept to `concepts`, or correct the panel's entity reference to an existing concept name (names are case-sensitive and must match exactly). Use `npdev_inspect_app` to list the concepts that already exist before referencing one.
fix: Add the concept to `concepts`, or fix the panel's entity reference to an existing concept name (exact, case-sensitive). List existing concepts with npdev_inspect_app first.
